title: Canonical chart cohomology lifts commute with stage transitions
statement: Let f:X→S, D:I→Over S be any small diagram, c a cone, F an abelian etale sheaf on X, q a natural number, j an index and W→D(j), V→c.pt etale test objects forming the specified pullback square. The chart diagram over j is obtained by pulling the arrows D(i)→D(j) back along X×_S D(j)→D(j). For every arrow a:m→l in Over j and every degree-q restricted cohomology class x at l, the canonical chart lift of x, followed by the shifted composition comparison and the cartesian derived image transition along D(a), equals the canonical chart lift at m of the specified restricted-cohomology transition of x. The canonical lift is inverse raw evaluation, chart adjunction and exact inverse-image class pullback [def-sc-cartesian-chart-class-pullback-core], with its free-sheaf source identified by the given test pullback square. All maps are the specified constructions; no invertibility of exchange or geometric conditions on f,D,c are assumed.

proof.text: For a:m→l above j, take the underlying arrow t of the chart diagram. Its first projection is the stage map followed by the first projection and its second projection is unchanged, by pullback.lift_fst and Over.w. Compose the latter with the projection to the j base. The cone equations identify all free sources.

Use restrictedOverCohomologyMap_eq_rawAffine to identify the specified stage map with the raw affine map and its inverse composition coefficient comparison. Apply rawRestrictedCohomologyClass_naturality: this follows from raw comparison naturality and injectivity of the canonical evaluation isomorphism. Thus the canonical raw class at m is raw pullback of the class at l.

Keep the derived pullback construction named while substituting the composition and structure-map equalities. Expand it only after those transports. sourceComp identifies the single-source comparison for a composite. The generic shift_pull_comp calculation uses functoriality, naturality and NatTrans.shift_app_comm; the proved plusNatIso_commShift and plusCompIso_commShift helpers supply shift compatibility. Precompose by the common free-source comparison. This gives composition of chart pullback, and shift naturality gives its compatibility with postcomposition.

Use chartRawAdj_pullback, the existing unprecomposed private calculation recorded in lem-sc-cartesian-chart-raw-adjunction-pullback: expand the derived exchange as the mate of the pullback-square comparison under the actual derived inverse-image/direct-image adjunctions, use shifted adjunct-mate transport, and identify the transported restriction class by pullback uniqueness. Compose with the chart pullback composition and postcomposition equations just proved. Apply this equality to the two canonical raw classes from the preceding step. Unfold the specified lift (which uses the uniquely determined inverse evaluation class) to obtain exactly the asserted stage naturality. No affine, qcqs, limit or exchange-invertibility assumptions enter.

theorem cartesianChartCohomologyLift_naturality
    {S X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] (D : I ⥤ Over S) (c : Cone D)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℕ)
    (j : I) (W : (D.obj j).left.Etale) (V : c.pt.left.Etale)
    (r : V.left ⟶ W.left)
    (hr : IsPullback r V.hom W.hom (c.π.app j).left)
    (l m : Over j) (a : m ⟶ l)
    (x : restrictedOverCohomology (pullback.snd f (D.obj j).hom)
      (((pullback.fst f (D.obj j).hom)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj F)
      (q : ℤ) ((cartesianChartDiagram f D j).obj l) W) :
    cartesianChartCohomologyLift f D c F q j W V r hr l x ≫
      (shiftFunctor _ (q : ℤ)).map
        ((upperStarCompDerivedPlus AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}
          (c.π.app m.left).left (D.map a.left).left (c.π.app l.left).left
          (congrArg (fun t ↦ t.left) (c.w a.left)).symm).hom.app _ ≫
          (D+(((c.π.app m.left).left)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}])).map
            (cartesianDerivedImageMap f (D.obj l.left).hom (D.obj m.left).hom
              (D.map a.left).left (Over.w (D.map a.left)).symm
              ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F))) =
      cartesianChartCohomologyLift f D c F q j W V r hr m
        (restrictedOverCohomologyMap (pullback.snd f (D.obj j).hom)
          (((pullback.fst f (D.obj j).hom)^*[AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}]).obj F)
          (q : ℤ) ((cartesianChartDiagram f D j).map a) W x)
